verses.text: Haton juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal Jehová t'ayin Sofonías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Cus, yixchikin in winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Amarías yuninal winhaj Ezequías. Ayik ayoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin.
Ha Jehová ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Ol in satel masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um tik.
Ol in satel heb' anima, ol in satel nok' nok', nok' much yet' pax nok' chay. Ol in satel heb' chuk yet' schukal. Ol in satel heb' anima t'a sat lum lum tik.

Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Judá yet' pax t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén. Ol in satel juntzanh b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios skuchan Baal t'a jun chonhab' tik. Manhxa b'aj ol cheklajkanok yet' pax sb'i heb' sacerdote ol in suksatok.
Ol in satel heb' sk'e t'a yib'anhtak pat lesal t'a masanil tas chekel t'a satcha'anh. Ol in satpaxel heb' tz'em kuman yik tzin yak'an b'inajok, palta syak'pax b'inaj sdiosal heb' skuch Milcom.
Ol in satpaxel heb' syik'el sb'a t'ayin, haton heb' max yal sb'a t'ayin, heb' max yak'em sb'a yik sk'anb'an sb'a t'ayin.
Numan tzex aj t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yujto a sk'uhal yowal in k'o'ol, lak'anxo ay. Toxo ix in sik'el nok' nok' ol in milcham silab'ok. Toxo pax ix in sik'kanel mach awtab'il wa'el wu'uj.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol wak' wal och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' yajal yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal heb' winh rey yet' pax t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo heb' tz'ak'anoch spichul heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.

Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' tz'ochb'at tz'itnaj t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub' spuertail templo, heb' syak' b'ut'jok stemplo skomon diosal yet' b'eyumal syik' heb' t'a spatik yelk'umal yet' pax yuj yak'an musansatil heb' yetanimail.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol ab'chaj yel yaw anima t'a puerta b'aj tz'och heb' chonhum chay t'a schab'il makan chonhab'. Ol ab'chaj sk'anh yel k'akap t'a lum tzalkixtak.
Awajanhek, mach ex kajan ex t'a mercado, yujto masanil heb' chonhwajum ol chamel heb', masanil heb' tz'ak'an tumin majanil, ol satel heb'.

Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol in say wil Jerusalén, icha tz'aj saychaj junok tas satb'at yet' te' tz'iktaj. Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' anima malaj tas sna' tiknaik, lajan heb' icha wino tonhej tanhanem yich, syal heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová, max yak'kotlaj wach'il t'a kib'anh, hanhejtona' manh ol yak'paxkotlaj chukal, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' a masanil jantak sb'eyumal heb', ol ik'chajek'ok yet' spat heb' ol juchajemok. Ol sb'ok'e spat heb', palta manhok heb' ol kajnaj t'a yo'ol. Ol yawej yuwa heb', palta manhok heb' ol uk'an swinoal, xchi Jehová.
Lak'anxo ay jun sk'uhal yowal sk'ol Jehová. Te niwan yelk'och jun k'uhal chi'. Lak'anxo ay, yelk'olal sjawi. Ab'ek, ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', wach'chom heb' soldado te tek'an, ol ok' heb' yuj xiwelal.

Ha jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal yowal sk'ol Jehová, sk'uhal ya'elal yet' kusk'olal. Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol juwokel chonhab', tz'inini ol ajkanok, ol k'ik'b'ok k 'inal, k'ik'alk'inalxonhej ol ajok, ol muslajpaxok, wewenxonhej ol ajkanok.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal spukhaj k'e'en trompeta yik owal yet' yel yaw heb' soldado yak'an owal t'a chonhab' ayoch smuroal yet' storreal te cha'anh yajk'ei.

Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak' wal och heb' anima t'a ilk'olal, yuj chi' lajan ol aj sb'eyek' heb' icha sb'eyek' heb' max uji yilani, yujto sik'lab'il ix och schukal heb' t'a wichanh. Ha schik'il heb', ol b'atkan kib'naj icha lum pokok, haxo sniwanil heb', toxonhej ol k'ekan b'ulan icha stza' nok' nok', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ha t'a sk'uhal yowal sk'ol Jehová, a k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en splata heb' anima, manhxo ol yal skoljiel heb' yuj k'e'en. Yujto a yowal sk'ol chi' ol ak'an satel jun nación tik. Manh junipok ol satel masanil heb' kajan t'a jun nación tik. Icha tz'aj stz'ab'at junok tas yuj te' k'ak', icha chi' ol aj satel heb'.
